name: zorp Mail
author: tom
description: Unread mail from zorp's local cache in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: An envelope with an unread count. Hover it for the newest mail in the watched folders; click to open zorp.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read zorp's cache. This is a local SQLite read, not a network call; the zorp daemon does the syncing.

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: When off, the list opens on right-click only.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer must rest on the icon before the list appears.
